trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Input tensor shape [1]; out tensor shape [5,1,1,1] is broadcast-incompatible with the expected result.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Calling torch.mul, torch.div, or torch.remainder with an out= parameter and an invalid out tensor shape.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Binary elementwise op with out= on CPU; input shape [1], scalar other 1, out shape [5,1,1,1].

bug_oracle.description: Segmentation fault (core dumped) when an incompatible out tensor shape is used with binary ops.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate diverse input and out shape combinations for ops with out=, especially broadcast-incompatible shapes.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create small input tensors and out tensors with mismatched broadcast dimensions, including higher-rank out tensors.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Target elementwise binary ops that support out= such as torch.mul, torch.div, and torch.remainder, using scalar or tensor operands.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call the target op with input, other, and out=out where out shape is incompatible with the broadcast result.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Expect a RuntimeError or Exception for invalid out shape; treat SIGSEGV or process abort as a crash bug.
